value: Femdom-focused 3D dungeoncrawler with monstergirl femdom. Final boss is a tentacled giantess.

Suspecting the imminent resurrection of the Demon Lord Nakara, hero Ernest is commanded by the Supreme Goddess to investigate her dungeon. Ernest is defeated and captured along with a young mage named Victor, and will have to work together to escape Nakara’s dungeon while fighting the monsters under her command.
